items.title: Actual Gaussian quadratic means on the cosine spectrum

items.statement: Under the actual centered Gaussian with diagonal inverse-precision covariance, the squared norm and cosine quadratic form have the reciprocal-spectrum means below. Both integrands are integrable. \mathbb E\|U\|^2=\sum_{i=1}^{d}\lambda_i^{-1},\qquad\mathbb E[U^\top D_nU]=\sum_{i=1}^{d}\frac{\cos(n\theta_i)}{\lambda_i}. Fix integers \(d\ge2\) and \(1\le n<d\), and a real parameter \(\kappa\ge2\). Lean represents the positive integer mode by a natural number with these exact bounds. For \(i=1,\ldots,d\), set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), and \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\). The Lean index is \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,d\), so its angle is \((i.\mathrm{val}+1/2)\pi/d\). Let \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\) in real Euclidean space and \(D_n=\operatorname{diag}(\cos(n\theta_i))\). The measure is literally \(\mathrm{multivariateGaussian}\,0\,\Lambda^{-1}\); its matrix argument is covariance, while \(\Lambda\) is precision. The displayed quadratic form has coordinate presentation \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\): multiplication by a diagonal matrix scales its ith coordinate, and the dot product then gives this sum. No arbitrary law, covariance witness or moment certificate is supplied.

obligations.label: Actual Gaussian squared-norm mean is the reciprocal spectrum sum.
Actual cosine quadratic mean is the weighted reciprocal spectrum sum.
Both actual Gaussian integrands are integrable.

bindings.boundary: This packet proves the actual diagonal Gaussian expectation-to-grid identities and an actual private summable Gaussian cosine alias-series precursor. Closed C8 tail partitions/resummations, fourth moments/independence/variances, normalized bias, orthogonal target transport, Krylov and adaptive algorithm/output laws remain open. Exact oracle, TV precision, deterministic worst-case query caps, explicit expected-cost adapters and both full main lower bounds remain open. Independent source verification, shared integration, desktop/mobile/graph acceptance, remote publication and purification/Exposition Seal are separate stages.
